learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamental management aspects of industrial organization: quality, logistics, reliability, human resources, and maintenance.
Analyze the economic and social implications of possible alternatives to a given problem.
Work and achieve consensus within your work group.

syllabus_topics: The business idea
Generation of business ideas: methodologies and workshop
Creativity - How to innovate in the business idea. Business idea innovation workshop
Sources of business ideas
Selecting business ideas: from idea to business opportunity
The business model. Methodology and workshop
Workshop: my first prototype with business models. Design of business models - Methodologies that help us design business models
Validation of business models: lean start up - Methodologies for validating business models
Key aspects of business models: innovation and scalability. Business model innovation workshop
Final design of the business model. From idea to model
Financing aspects: the feasibility plan
The promoting team
Presenting the idea: communication and marketing. Low-cost marketing
The business plan. Aspects of the business plan
Different legal forms that can shape your project: fiscal aspects, processing, self-employment aid in Navarra, characteristics of each legal form
Commercial and labor procedures
Entities that support entrepreneurs in Navarra
Resources for entrepreneurship: online and offline
Entrepreneurs
Learning from success and failure
Entrepreneurial competencies
Improvement of entrepreneurial competencies
Entities that support entrepreneurs
Service charter offered by each entity
Financial resources
Online resources, essential blogs
Networking
Databases: economic, business ideas, statistics
Media related to entrepreneurs offline and online
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a project (60%) and an exam (40%). Both components are recoverable. A minimum grade of 3 is required for each component to pass.
